versions.changelog:
subagent-archive v3.2.0 brings cross-platform workspace detection, multi-workspace support, and enhanced compatibility for OpenClaw 6.1+.

- Added automatic workspace directory scanning and new `-WorkspaceDir` parameter for flexible multi-workspace handling (Windows/macOS/Linux).
- Enhanced support for both PowerShell 5.1 and 7+; paths and environment detection now work seamlessly across platforms.
- Maintains all v3.1 features, including dashboard parent session segregation, soft-deletion, and safe archiving rules.
- Documentation updates: more concise, neutralized author credits, expanded compatibility matrix, and improved code samples.
- Added extensive usage examples, new test scripts, and file structure documentation to assist users and maintainers.

- Added initial SKILL.md documentation file with placeholder content.
- Bumped version to 1.2.0.
